tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: App background on every screen. Near-black, not #000, so OLED scrolling doesn't smear.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards and grouped rows on ground: exercise cards, stat cards, set rows.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Inputs, steppers and pressed states on surface; the bottom tab bar.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers inside a card only. Never the only thing separating controls.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and the big numbers on ground, surface and surface-raised (15.9:1 or better).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and labels on ground, surface and surface-raised (5.6:1 or better); undone set ticks.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Disabled and placeholder hints only, never information the user needs (below 3:1 on purpose).

tokens.name: spotter-red
tokens.usage: The logo red, exact. Fills and marks only: the dot, the active set, done ticks, PR moments, primary button fill. As text only at 24px+ (4.2:1 on ground).

tokens.name: red-text
tokens.usage: Red text under 24px on ground, surface and surface-raised (4.7:1 or better), e.g. 'new best'.

tokens.name: on-red
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a spotter-red fill (4.7:1).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a number and its unit.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between set rows; icon to label.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Top of a screen to its title; around the hero number in Workout mode.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets and the exercise demo frame.
